dossier.scp_unleashed.420j.title: The Best In The World
dossier.scp_unleashed.420j.caption: SCP-420-J parent plant at intake. It did not mind.

page.title: Special Containment Procedures:
text: SCP-420-J is grown in an ordinary bed of tilled soil with reasonable sunlight, and is watered whenever somebody remembers. %rA request for a larger bed has been denied three times.%r
Rolled specimens are kept in a standard storage container in a low-security wing, well away from the break room. **SCP-420-J is not to be used beneath low ceilings.**

page.title: Description:
text: SCP-420-J is the best %rthing%r in the world.

That was the whole of the original description. The Ethics Committee asked for more, so: SCP-420-J is a hand-rolled paper cylinder about eight centimetres long, slightly tapered, grey-white, with a tip that is always gently glowing. Nobody has ever been seen lighting it.
New specimens can be rolled from the leaves of the SCP-420-J parent plant, an unremarkable hemp plant in every way that can be measured. It grows from seed like any other crop.

Subjects who light SCP-420-J describe the world as "turned up a bit". A short piece of cheerful island music is heard nearby, from no source that can be found. The subject's feet always come back down eventually.

page.title: Addendum 420-J-1: Test Log
text: Test 420-J-01: D-Class subject. Subject reported feeling great. Subject was correct.
Test 420-J-02: Researcher Holt, against advice. Holt was later found on the canteen roof and asked to fill in a form. The form was not filled in.
Test 420-J-03: Lit indoors. The ceiling held. %rSo did the subject.%r
Test 420-J-04: Agent Price asked if the music could be changed. It could not.

page.title: Addendum 420-J-2: Note
page.text: This file was submitted as a joke. Please stop submitting it. %rIt keeps getting approved.%r

page.title: Addendum 420-J-3: Provenance
page.text: The first seeds were handed to a reader of this file by a very relaxed individual in Foundation dress. The individual said they were for research, and then said it again, more slowly. See field notes.

item.scp_unleashed.scp420j_seeds.tooltip: Plant on farmland. Water optional, vibes mandatory.
item.scp_unleashed.scp420j_leaf.tooltip: Smells faintly of a beach you have never been to.
item.scp_unleashed.scp420j_joint.tooltip: The best in the world, according to its own file.
item.scp_unleashed.scp420j_joint.use: Use to light it up and see what happens

jei.scp_unleashed.info.scp420j_joint.1: SCP-420-J. Officially the best in the world. The Foundation has asked it to stop saying that.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.scp420j_joint.2: Rolled from two hemp leaves and a sheet of paper. Light it up and relax. Something nice happens, and then it stops happening.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.scp420j_joint.3: Researchers report a strong urge to describe colours as "really colourful". Their reports have not been accepted.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.scp420j_joint.cre: Music: "Mandeville" by Kevin MacLeod (incompetech.com), CC BY 4.0
jei.scp_unleashed.info.scp420j_seeds.1: Hemp seeds for SCP-420-J. Plant them on farmland and they grow like any other crop. Bone meal helps.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.scp420j_seeds.2: A fully grown plant gives leaves and more seeds. The first handful arrives from a very relaxed stranger.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.scp420j_leaf.1: The serrated leaf of SCP-420-J. Roll two of them up in paper to make the anomaly itself.
